description: Secure drainage and power first, then cool the short route: generator on the cutting platform and both pumps at once (the works waits for power), the plant crew stages in the shelter and control room while the cutting drains; once the causeway is passable the crew moves to the crossing bank and crossing S is cooled twice (one refill). Late in the operation a pump is switched off so the works runs again. Steps from t=4250 repeat the crossing sequence for the Relaxed clock (no effect in Standard).
